definitions.explanation: A person who possesses substantial assets such as property, investments, or savings. Focuses on accumulated wealth and assets rather than high income.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}は{地元|じもと}でも{有名|ゆうめい}な{資産家|しさんか}だ。
examples.english: He is a well-known wealthy person in the local area.

examples.japanese: {祖父|そふ}は{不動産|ふどうさん}で{財|ざい}を{成|な}した{資産家|しさんか}だった。
examples.english: My grandfather was a wealthy man who made his fortune in real estate.

examples.japanese: {資産家|しさんか}の{多|おお}くは{税金|ぜいきん}{対策|たいさく}として{法人|ほうじん}を{設立|せつりつ}している。
examples.english: Many wealthy individuals establish corporations as a tax strategy.

notes:
USAGE:
{資産家|しさんか} emphasizes accumulated assets (property, investments, savings) rather than income. It is a neutral, respectful term without the negative connotations that words like {金持|かねも}ち can sometimes carry.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {大|だい}{資産家|しさんか} (very wealthy person)
- {資産家|しさんか}{一族|いちぞく} (wealthy family/clan)
- {地元|じもと}の{資産家|しさんか} (local person of means)

SIMILAR WORDS:
{金持|かねも}ち is the casual, everyday word for a rich person. {富裕層|ふゆうそう} refers to the wealthy class as a group. {資産家|しさんか} is more formal than {金持|かねも}ち and emphasizes asset ownership specifically.
